integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the defining CDF, the quantile/random-number-generator derivation, Table 1, and the simulation statement citing Eq. (10). The classical Lehmann-alternative exponentiation source was checked for the general construction. The impossibility proof is analytic, and the standalone numerical checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the printed quantile/random-generator equation but cannot determine which sign was used in unpublished simulation code.
The reported Table 1 quantiles agree with the corrected equation.
Other EHaq properties and empirical conclusions were not reassessed.
title: The printed EHaq random-generator equation has no admissible solution
